text: December's petrol price is expected to fall by more than three rand a litre. Here's how that number is made.
asr: December's petrol price is expected to fall by more than R3 a litre. Here's how that number is made.

text: It starts with oil. Oil prices fell over the past month.
asr: It starts with oil. Oil prices fell over the past month.

text: Then the rand. Oil is bought in dollars, and a weaker rand clawed back part of that saving.
asr: Then the rand. Oil is bought in dollars, and a weaker rand clawed back part of that saving.

text: Together, they set the basic fuel price, the biggest part of what you pay at the pump.
asr: Together, they set the basic fuel price, the biggest part of what you pay at the pump.

text: Then the fuel levy. Government's temporary relief shrinks on the second of December, from one rand fifty to one rand a litre for petrol. That adds back fifty cents.
asr: Then the fuel levy. Government's temporary relief shrinks on 2 December, from R1.50 to R1 a litre for petrol. That adds back 50c.

text: For diesel, the relief halves, from three rand to one rand fifty, so diesel users benefit much less.
asr: For diesel, the relief halves, from R3 to R1.50, so diesel users benefit much less.

text: The official prices are announced just before the change. The smaller relief runs until the fifth of January.
asr: The official prices are announced just before the change. The smaller relief runs until 5 January.

text: Mmzahnsee Money Matters. Know where your money is going.
asr: Mzansi Money Matters. Know where your money is going.
